title: Tree attaining decision tree size
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\alpha$ be a type, and let $f:(\mathbb{F}_2)^n\to\alpha$ be any function. There is a decision tree on all $n$ coordinates that computes $f$ and whose number of leaves equals the decision tree size of $f$.
